captions.caption: A shot of a diamond-plate metal toolbox mounted in the bed of a pickup truck.
The interior of a truck bed is shown with a gooseneck hitch ball installed in the center.
A close-up view of the gooseneck hitch ball inside the ribbed bed of a truck.
A man stands on the ground and uses a handle to adjust a trailer's hitch mechanism.
From a high angle, a man is seen operating a lever on a black flatbed trailer.
The man continues to operate the trailer's hitch handle while standing on a dirt surface.
A trailer's gooseneck coupler is lowered onto the hitch ball in the back of a truck.
The trailer hitch is secured onto the ball inside the truck bed.
A view from the truck bed shows the trailer's gooseneck coupler connected to the ball.
A man wearing a neon yellow cap leans over to adjust a pin on the trailer's support leg.
The man in the yellow cap works on the trailer's landing gear in a sunny outdoor setting.
The man continues to manipulate the locking mechanism of the trailer's support leg.
The man stands up after finishing the adjustment of the trailer's support leg.
A person's hand reaches for the locking pin on the trailer's adjustable support post.
The person pulls the metal pin to release the trailer's support leg.
A hand pulls the trailer's support leg upward to retract it.
The trailer's support leg is fully retracted, leaving a wooden block on the ground.
A hand reaches down to pick up a thick wooden block from the grass.
The wooden block is lifted from the ground by a person's hand.
The person carries the wooden block away from the trailer's hitch area.
A wide shot shows the truck and trailer parked in a grassy field.
A black wheel chock is positioned behind the rear tire of the flatbed trailer.
The camera focuses on the trailer's wheel and the chock preventing it from rolling.
A hand reaches toward the bottom of the trailer wheel to grab a rope.
The person's hand grabs the rope attached to the wheel chock.
The wheel chock is pulled away from the trailer tire using the attached rope.
The person lifts the wheel chock off the ground to clear it from the trailer.
A view of the long flatbed trailer parked on a dirt path with trees in the background.
The camera pans across the yard toward a large shed housing farm equipment.
A red tractor and other machinery are parked inside a metal-roofed shed.
A pile of heavy metal chains lies on the wooden floor of the flatbed trailer.
The heavy chains remain in focus on the trailer's deck.
A close-up shot of the metal chains used for securing equipment.
The chains are seen resting on the wooden planks of the trailer.
The camera maintains its position on the chain pile on the trailer.
A steady shot of the heavy chains on the wooden trailer bed.
The camera view remains on the chains as the tractor is about to appear.
A red tractor is seen approaching the trailer from a distance in the yard.
The red tractor continues to drive across the dirt yard toward the trailer.
The tractor moves closer to the back of the flatbed trailer.
The red tractor aligns itself to load onto the trailer.
The tractor continues its approach toward the trailer's loading ramps.
The red tractor moves slowly toward the rear of the trailer.
The tractor is now very close to the trailer ramps.
The red tractor prepares to drive onto the flatbed trailer.
The tractor begins its ascent onto the trailer deck.
A low-angle view looking up at the red metal frame of the tractor's loader.
The camera angle shifts to show the front part of the tractor from below.
A view of the hydraulic lines and engine components under the tractor.
The camera inspects the underside of the tractor's chassis.
A view of the tractor's rear three-point hitch and hydraulic system.
A large treaded tire of the tractor is shown parked on the trailer.
The camera focuses on the chains used to secure the tractor to the trailer.
A close-up shot of the metal chains on the trailer's wooden deck.
A man in a cap stands in front of the loaded trailer and smiles.
The man begins speaking to the camera about the equipment setup.
The man gestures toward the red tractor on the trailer behind him.
The man continues his explanation while standing in the sunny yard.
The man talks to the camera with the truck and trailer clearly visible.
The man finishes his presentation as he stands next to the loaded trailer.
